title: Contrasting Cognitive Styles in Vision-Language Models: Holistic Attention in Japanese Versus Analytical Focus in English

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying generated image captions as holistic (background-focused) or analytic (object-focused) to measure cognitive style differences across Vision-Language Models evaluated on Western versus East Asian (Japanese) image datasets.

Analyzing how the output language (English vs. Japanese) and linguistic structure influence the generation of holistic versus analytic image descriptions, including cross-lingual prompting and back-translation experiments.
